milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find chest' is a locate/observe task. The chest is at spawn-relative (3, 0, 6), which is ~6.7 blocks from spawn. max_distance=3 ensures the player must actually walk to the chest (not satisfy from spawn). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because selling wheat to the farmer villager produces emeralds that appear in the player's inventory. No emeralds exist in the scene initially (not in chest, not in inventory), so having ≥1 emerald is definitive proof the wheat sale occurred.

Uses inventory_has because trading emeralds with the villager produces apples that appear in the player's inventory. No apples exist in the scene initially, so having ≥1 apple is definitive proof the emerald-for-apple trade was completed.
